sector: Luxury residential: full floor residences in a converted warehouse block, sold through a single broker's video channel.
founded_place_size: Founded 2022, a converted warehouse block of nine full floor residences, sold one at a time through one broker's channel of three or four videos a month.
about: Sterling Row is nine full floor residences in a converted warehouse block, starting just over four million dollars, sold to buyers who are not in a hurry and have seen everything. The channel is where most buyers first meet the broker, so every piece has to feel made by one hand. Restraint is the whole proposition: these buyers are reassured, not persuaded.
audience: Ultra high net worth buyers, typically on their third or fourth property, reassured by evidence and calm rather than by benefit claims, who still need the floor, the square footage and the exposure before they ask to view.
price_positioning: Full floor residences from just over four million dollars, the top of the market. Presentation sits near neutral and deliberately small: anything that looks like a promotion reads, at this tier, as a building that is struggling to sell.
typography: One reassuring, near neutral pairing that avoids both extremes: no high contrast display serif that reads as a perfume advert, no heavy grotesque that reads as a development brochure. Text sits small and calm, the wordmark reproduces modestly, on screen copy is minimal by rule.
voice: Spare, composed, confident without pressure. Example: "Nine residences. Full floor. Sold one at a time, to buyers in no hurry."
brand_assets_status: The only surviving version of the wordmark is a handheld photograph of the cast brass plaque mounted in the lobby, lit from one side. There is no vector file and no clean scan. The developer's spec sheet exists only as a printed PDF, and the disclosure wording is fixed and cannot be changed.
values: Discretion and accuracy. The developer's restraint rules and disclosure lines are contractual, and the brand is protected by never looking like it is selling.
